outline.title: IntentGuard
outline.summary: Title slide presenting IntentGuard as the transaction-intent firewall for autonomous finance, with Orion Builder Hackathon, Base, and confirm-first positioning.

outline.title: The wallet shows a request. It does not show intent.
outline.summary: Show the gap between a user thinking they are claiming an airdrop and a wallet request that grants unlimited allowance.

outline.title: IntentGuard makes the mismatch impossible to miss.
outline.summary: Explain the product flow: state intent, decode request, and compare actual effect to hard limits.

outline.title: One decision. Three outcomes. Zero false confidence.
outline.summary: Present MATCH, MISMATCH, and CANNOT VERIFY as the product’s memorable safety states.
outline.image_plan: /home/ubuntu/intentguard-mvp/presentation/assets/intentguard-cannot-verify-wireframe.png - Slide 3, product UI showing cannot verify and fail-closed state

outline.title: This is intent fidelity—not another risk score.
outline.summary: Position IntentGuard against token research dashboards, wallet diagnostics, and generic transaction-security products.

outline.title: The agent investigates. Deterministic code decides.
outline.summary: Show the end-to-end architecture from intent normalization and decoding through evidence, policy engine, verdict, explanation, and receipt anchoring.

outline.title: Safety is a product feature—and a trust boundary.
outline.summary: Explain the non-custodial, read-only, fail-closed, no-arbitrary-execution MVP boundary and its honest limitation around EOAs.

outline.title: The demo proves the product in under 90 seconds.
outline.summary: Show the three core scenarios: exact approval passes, unlimited approval fails, EIP-2612 permit is decoded, and unknown selectors fail closed.

outline.title: Every verdict leaves a verifiable trail.
outline.summary: Explain versioned evidence hashes, policy commitments, evaluator-signed receipts, expiry, revocation, and Base Sepolia anchoring.

outline.title: Built for Orion’s agent economy.

outline.title: We win by being the agent that refuses to guess.
outline.summary: Map usefulness, execution, originality, and security proof to the judge rubric and state the integration ask.

outline.title: Autonomous finance earns trust by proving what it means.
